name: SmartContent TarahiBerooz
author: Alireza Zargaran

sections.description:
SmartContent TarahiBerooz is an advanced WordPress plugin developed by TarahiBerooz that automates the process of content creation and publishing. The plugin leverages modern AI technologies to generate complete, high-quality articles along with relevant images and publish them directly to your WordPress website.

By integrating multiple AI providers, SmartContent TarahiBerooz allows site administrators to choose the most suitable service for their needs while maintaining full control over content style, structure, and scheduling.

This plugin is designed to streamline content workflows, reduce manual effort, and help maintain a consistent flow of fresh and engaging content.

Compliance and External Services

This plugin uses third-party external services to provide its core functionality, in accordance with the WordPress Plugin Review Guidelines (Guideline 6).

External Services Used:
– OpenRouter API (https://openrouter.ai)
– OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com)
– Google Generative Language API (Gemini) (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com)

Data Sent to External Services:
When content generation is requested, the plugin sends the following data to the selected AI service via secure HTTPS requests:
– API key provided by the site administrator
– Content-related inputs such as title, keywords, prompts, language preferences, and formatting options

No personal data of site visitors or logged-in users is collected or transmitted.

Purpose of Data Transmission:
The external services are required to:
– Generate AI-written textual content
– Generate or assist in generating relevant images
– Process and return AI-generated data for publishing

Without these external services, the plugin cannot perform its primary functions.

Service Selection and Data Handling:
The site administrator can select the desired AI provider from the plugin settings page. API keys are stored locally in the WordPress database and are only used to communicate with the selected external service. The plugin does not share data with any other third parties.

Terms of Service and Privacy Policies:
Users are encouraged to review the official terms and privacy policies of each service:
– OpenRouter: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy available on the OpenRouter website
– OpenAI: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy available on the OpenAI website
– Google Gemini API: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy available in Google’s official documentation

Features

  • AI-Powered Content Generation: Automatically generate complete articles using modern AI models.
  • Multiple AI Providers: Choose between OpenRouter, OpenAI, and Google Gemini.
  • Automatic Image Generation: Generate and attach relevant images to posts using AI.
  • Smart Scheduling: Schedule content publishing to maintain a consistent posting schedule.
  • SEO-Friendly Output: Generated content is structured for readability and search engine optimization.
  • Admin-Controlled Settings: Full control over prompts, keywords, and publishing behavior.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the SmartContent TarahiBerooz settings page.
  4. Select your preferred AI provider.
  5. Enter the corresponding API key provided by the selected service.
  6. Configure content generation options and start creating posts.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of the SmartContent TarahiBerooz plugin.
  • Added AI-powered text generation using OpenRouter, OpenAI, and Google Gemini APIs.
  • Implemented automated image generation and insertion.
  • Added smart scheduling and automated publishing features.
  • Included logging for content generation events.
